'''Taylor Alesia''' (born October 13, 1996) is an American YouTuber, singer, and social-media personality. She appears in [[Media and Personalities]] as a '''YouTuber entry''' — a look at what she actually makes, in the lighter content-first style the section uses for individual creators.

== What she makes ==

Alesia came up through the first wave of livestream-native creators: she started on the '''YouNow''' livestreaming platform in 2015, launched her YouTube channel in May 2015, and posted her debut video — a '''makeup tutorial''' — that August. The channel settled into the familiar influencer mix: '''vlogs, makeup tutorials, challenges, and storytime videos''', the day-in-the-life and personality content that defined mid-2010s YouTube. She grew a following in the low millions and extended it across TikTok, Instagram, and Twitch.

== Music ==

Alongside the vlogging she pursued music. Her best-known upload is the 2017 song and visual '''"Stay the Night,"''' her most-viewed video with well over ten million views, and she has released several other tracks, including "Born Again" (2021).

== Notes ==

Her career also tracks the real human cost of the always-on creator life: in late 2019 she publicly stepped back from social media to recover from depression before later returning to streaming. We mention it not as gossip but because that arc — burnout and return — is one of the defining, under-discussed patterns of the influencer era this section documents.
